name: Schedule I
description: Chatters become customers in Schedule I: !customer puts their name on a customer in your game, and chat hears when they order or buy. Also: workers named after chatters (!staff), donations as cash drops, chat picks the mixing ingredient, suppliers (!tab, !supply) and dealer sponsors (!sponsor). Needs the FridgeSchedule1 MelonLoader mod (or its mock server on port 3857).

command_group.description: Schedule I customers, staff, cash drops, suppliers, dealers and mixes (!customer, !topcustomers, !mug, !mixname, !staff, !topstaff, !drop, !tab, !supply, !sponsor, !topdealers)

pages.title: Schedule I customers
pages.keywords: schedule one schedule i customers chatters names npc

settings.label: Mod URL
settings.help: Where the FridgeSchedule1 mod (or START Schedule1 Mock.bat) listens

settings.label: Mod token
settings.help: Optional. Same text as Token in the mod's MelonPreferences.cfg

settings.label: Join without !customer
settings.help: subs = subscribers / members join when they chat; everyone = every chatter

settings.label: Name customers you've already met first
Newly named customers text you an order soon
settings.help: When a chatter's name lands on a customer you've already met, that customer texts you an order a few seconds later (unless they already have a deal, an open order or a dealer). In co-op only the host's setting counts.

settings.label: Only put chatter names on the extra regulars
settings.help: Only the ten Regulars (FridgeRegulars.dll) carry chatter names; everyone else waits for one. Chatters on normal customers move to a free Regular or back to waiting. Pair it with Shifts so names take turns.

settings.label: Most named customers at once
settings.help: 0 = every customer can carry a chatter name

settings.label: Shift ends after this many deals
settings.help: 0 = off. When someone is waiting, a chatter whose customer made this many deals goes to the back of the line and the next chatter takes over. Their totals are kept.

settings.label: Shift ends after (minutes)
settings.help: 0 = off. Same as above, by time on the customer (for customers who rarely order).

settings.label: Subscribers / members keep their customer
settings.help: Shifts never end for subs. Updated when they type !customer or join on their own.

settings.label: Name in the game
settings.help: chatter = 'zackfan99'; chatter_last = 'zackfan99 Cooley'

settings.label: Say in chat when someone becomes a customer
Say in chat when a chatter-customer orders
Say in chat when a chatter-customer's deal goes through
Show stream alerts on the in-game phone
settings.help: Follows, subs, raids, tips ... pop up on your phone in Schedule I and go into the Chat app's feed. The Alerts page's test buttons work too.

settings.label: Which alerts
settings.help: Empty = all of them. Or pick kinds: follow, subscribe, resub, gift, raid, host, bits, superchat, donation, member, ...

settings.label: Chat can mug you (!mug)
settings.help: A chatter pays points and cartel goons come out of the nearest building after you. In co-op it hits your own player.

settings.label: Price (points)
settings.help: Refunded when the game can't do it (no save loaded, you're knocked out, no goons free).

settings.label: 'Let chat name it' button on the naming screen
settings.help: When you make a new mix, press 'Let chat name it' on the game's naming screen: chat suggests names with !mixname, then votes !1 !2 ... Press the button again (or name it yourself) to stop.

settings.label: Time for name ideas (s)
settings.help: 0 = no ideas from chat: chat votes on the game's own name ideas straight away.

settings.label: Names to vote on
settings.help: The ideas most chatters suggested go in first; the game's own ideas fill the rest.

settings.label: Always include one of the game's names
Name the mix as soon as the vote ends
settings.help: Off = chat's pick is typed into the name box and you press Confirm yourself (or change it).

settings.label: Words never allowed in a name
settings.help: Ideas containing any of these (any case, also inside longer words) are refused.

settings.label: Workers carry chatter names (!staff)
settings.help: Your botanists, chemists, packagers and cleaners get the names of chatters who type !staff, and chat hears what they got done. Names come off while the game saves, so they never reach your save. Host only in co-op.

settings.label: Who can be staff
settings.help: subs = subscribers / members only

settings.label: A chatter is a customer or a worker, not both
Say in chat what workers did
At most one line per worker every (s)
settings.help: Jobs in between are added up: 'harvested a plant x3, watered a plant x5'.

settings.label: Worker changes hands after (minutes)
settings.help: 0 = off. Only when someone is waiting for a worker.

settings.label: Donations become cash drops
settings.help: Bits, Super Chats, tips, gifted subs and KICKs put in-game cash in a dead drop, with the donor's message as a note. You get a pop-up and a map marker; chat hears when you pick it up. The Alerts page test buttons work too. Host only in co-op.

settings.label: Which alerts
settings.help: Empty = bits, superchat, donation, supersticker, kicks, gift, powerup, celebration.

settings.label: In-game $ per real $1
settings.help: 100 bits or 100 KICKs count as $1, a gifted sub as $5, other currencies 1:1.

settings.label: Smallest tip that makes a drop (real $)
Most in-game $ per drop
settings.help: 0 = no limit

settings.label: Most in-game $ since Stream Core started
settings.help: 0 = no limit

settings.label: !drop price (points)
settings.help: 0 = no !drop command

settings.label: Say in chat where the cash is and when it's picked up
'Let chat pick' button on the mixing station
settings.help: Put a product in a mixing station and press 'Let chat pick': chat votes !1 !2 ... for the ingredient. The winner shows on the screen; you put it in yourself.

settings.label: Pick from
settings.help: carried = only ingredients you have (in the places ticked under 'Take ingredients from'; all of them when you have none); all = any ingredient in the game, even ones you don't have, for when you'll go and buy it

settings.label: Put chat's pick in the station for me
settings.help: When the vote ends, the winning ingredient moves into the mixing station (as many as there is product, if you have that many). You still press Begin. Off = you put it in yourself.

settings.label: Take ingredients from: my inventory
settings.help: What you carry. Used for 'Pick from: carried' and for putting the pick in. Nothing ticked = this one.

settings.label: Take ingredients from: this property / nearby
settings.help: Shelves, racks and safes in the mixing station's property, and your vehicles parked near it.

settings.label: Take ingredients from: all owned storage
settings.help: Storage at every property you own and all your vehicles. Co-op guests only ever use their own inventory.

settings.label: Chat can help with suppliers (!tab, !supply)
settings.help: !tab albert 500 pays toward what you owe a supplier; !supply albert makes them leave some of their goods at a dead drop from the chatter. Only suppliers you've met. Host only in co-op.

settings.label: In-game $ per point for !tab
settings.help: 0.2 = 500 points pay $100. Points for more than you owe come back.

settings.label: Chatters can back your dealers (!sponsor)
settings.help: A chatter pays points to back a dealer: it shows as 'Benji (zackfan99)', chat hears its sales, robberies and empty stock, and the sponsor earns points from its sales. Host only in co-op.

settings.label: Lowest bid (points)
settings.help: Taking over a dealer costs more than its sponsor paid.

settings.label: Outbid sponsors get their points back
Points for the sponsor per $100 sold
At most one sales line per dealer every (s)
